tasks.short: Assess venue and lighting conditions and write the resulting makeup requirements.

steps.what: Retrieve venue information, lighting plans and the production brief
Evaluate environmental characteristics and observe the venue and lighting conditions
Clarify lighting intentions and production constraints with the relevant colleagues
Determine makeup requirements from the environmental assessment
Write the assessed venue conditions and makeup requirements in the production notes

tasks.design: Configure production-linked reference views and an environmental assessment layout in {DOCS}. Venue observation, colleague discussion and makeup judgement remain human; writing the assessed requirements is a separate step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lighting versions and venue references can be scattered, while recurring assessment headings are rewritten.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and reusable assessment headings can reduce mechanical handling.
tasks.still_hard: How makeup will appear under the actual viewing distance and lighting.
tasks.human_edge: Visual judgement in the real venue and understanding production intent.
tasks.altitude: Keep a clearer production assessment with less repeated reference and note handling.

evidence.claim: Native production-linked references and assessment templates may reduce handling; this is E1 rather than a measured theatrical makeup result.

assumptions: The task includes the working requirements record separately from the venue visit and discussion.

Production colleagues supply venue and lighting documents; the artist identifies versions in s1, observes conditions in s2 and records production identity, assessed conditions and requirements in s5. Capture time is counted. Missing versions require manual clarification.
Try native reference views and templates before custom software. No automatic lighting interpretation or makeup selection is proposed.
Ordinary author saves stay fully retained without approval or independent saving.
unknowns: Actual amount of existing written assessment work
research_questions: Can linked versions and assessment headings reduce record handling without shortening the venue assessment?

already_counted.description: Full venue assessment, clarification and makeup judgement

incremental.description: Maintain production reference links and assessment layout

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R94 gives6 gross minus1 upkeep =5 net. Low: lighting files lack stable versions and assessment notes are bespoke, leaving lookup15 and writing14 plus70 unchanged, R99; net0. High: version links work but requirements wording remains individual, leaving13+13+70=96 retained; net3 after1 upkeep. Physical evaluation and makeup judgement remain full.

tasks.short: Develop a prosthesis concept and separately produce and check the design record.

steps.what: Clarify the performer's character, appearance and practical design constraints
Retrieve relevant rubber or plastic prosthesis references and existing design elements
Design the prosthesis shape and intended appearance for the performer
Produce the prosthesis drawing or model record and its design annotations
Check the prosthesis design against the brief, appearance and practical constraints

tasks.design: Organise design references in {DOCS} and configure reusable page structures or compatible layers in {OTHER}, the illustration or modelling editor. Artistic design and practical checking remain human; only repeated reference navigation and mechanical design-record layout are reduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design references and repeated drawing annotations may be recreated for each character.
tasks.enabler_now: Native library and layout features can reuse compatible structures without selecting the prosthesis design.
tasks.still_hard: Original appearance, performer-specific fit constraints and material suitability.
tasks.human_edge: Artistic and practical judgement about the real performer.
tasks.altitude: Develop prosthesis concepts with a more reusable design record.

evidence.claim: Native reference libraries and compatible drawing layouts may reduce mechanical design recording, but do not automate prosthesis design; benefit is E1.

assumptions: This is design, including its drawing or model record and practical review; fabrication and application are not silently counted as software savings.

The artist captures character and performer constraints in s1, selects references in s2 and supplies the concept and annotations in s3-s4. Missing reference metadata or incompatible layers require manual handling with effort retained.
The modest s4 reduction applies only to repeat layout and annotation structure. Physical model making and unique drawing content remain in retained work; native editor features are tested first.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained with no self-approval. No send or production commitment is proposed.
unknowns: Actual balance of physical models and digital drawings
Compatibility of existing design layers and annotation layouts
research_questions: Is there repeated compatible design-record layout work that native features can reduce while leaving artistic and physical work intact?

incremental.description: Maintain reference tags and compatible layouts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R94.25 gives5.75 gross minus1.5 upkeep =4.25 net. Low: physical models dominate and design layers are incompatible, leaving retrieval9.5 and record24 plus65 unchanged, R98.5; net0. High: some annotation structures fit but unique artwork stays manual, leaving retrieval9 and record22 plus65 unchanged, R96; net2.5 after1.5 upkeep.

tasks.short: Research period references, create character drawings or models and maintain the production file.

steps.what: Research and verify period references for the character drawings or models
Interpret the research and select the character's visual treatment
Create character drawings or model studies from the selected concept
outputs: draft character drawings or model studies

loop.purpose: Produce draft visual studies from the artist's selected concept
loop.input: Artist's concept, verified period references and intended visual constraints
loop.output: Draft character studies with links to their references
loop.check: Artist checks period details, character intent, practical makeup feasibility and unsupported visual invention
loop.stop: One revision pass; inaccurate studies or unsuitable physical-model work return to manual creation
loop.why_not_simpler: A layout template cannot produce a concept-specific visual study

steps.what: Check and revise the drawings or models against period sources and production needs
inputs: draft character drawings or model studies

steps.what: Augment the period production files with the checked studies and source references

tasks.design: Use native reference folders in {DOCS} and a bounded visual drafting loop in {OTHER}, the illustration or modelling editor. The artist independently researches and selects the concept, checks period meaning and practical suitability, then adds the final studies to the production file with its existing effort retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference retrieval and first visual studies take time before the artist can assess a treatment.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked visual drafts can offer a starting study for an artist's explicit concept.
tasks.still_hard: Period authenticity, character intent and practical translation into makeup.
tasks.human_edge: Independent artistic interpretation and recognising convincing but historically wrong details.
tasks.altitude: Compare visual studies while preserving independent research and artistic choice.

reach.task: Use a traceable period character study

evidence.claim: Reviewed visual drafting from an artist-supplied concept is a plausible E1 capability; no supplied case measures period-character design savings.

assumptions: The task includes independent research, concept selection, actual drawings or models, checking and the production-file write.

The artist identifies period and character in s1, verifies each source and supplies the chosen concept in s2. All capture and provenance work is counted; missing references or unsupported visual details require manual creation.
Try native reusable layouts first. The drafting gain applies to digital visual studies; physical model work and incompatible output formats remain within retained effort.
The ordinary production-file save in s5 is fully retained and ungated, with no independent saving. No external publication is proposed.
unknowns: Rights and permission for source material in the drafting environment
research_questions: Does a source-grounded visual draft reduce total study creation time after period and practical corrections?

already_counted.description: Visual draft review and full period and practical checking

incremental.description: Maintain reference provenance and review visual drafting failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R81 gives19 gross minus3 upkeep =16 net. Low: source images lack reliable period metadata and generated studies require major rebuilding, leaving research24 and creation32 plus40 unchanged, R96; net1. High: verified references and compatible output layers reduce rebuilding, leaving research22 and creation25 plus40 unchanged, R87; net10 after3 upkeep. Interpretation, final checking and file writing stay fully retained.

tasks.short: Demonstrate products, teach makeup application and separately record useful client follow-up.

steps.what: Retrieve relevant product instructions and the client's stated makeup needs
Prepare the products, tools and demonstration area
Check the intended demonstration and demonstrate the products to the client
Check and provide instruction in the selected makeup application techniques
Observe the client's practice and clarify remaining questions
Write the demonstrated products and useful follow-up points in the client notes

tasks.design: Link product references in {DOCS} and use a short demonstration-note layout in {CRM}. Physical preparation, the product demonstration, application instruction and client practice remain human; the existing client note is a separate write.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current product instructions and repeating product identifiers add small clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native product links and client-note fields can reduce navigation and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining techniques clearly and adapting to the client's understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Practical demonstration and responsive individual teaching.
tasks.altitude: Protect live demonstration time while retaining useful follow-up context.

reach.task: Locate the client's demonstrated product references

evidence.claim: Salonized client management supports treatment notes and client cards; this supports record capability rather than a measured demonstration saving.
The small reference and note handling benefit is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The baseline includes existing brief demonstration notes, averaged across contacts; no new report is required after every demonstration.
The artist supplies product identity and client request in s1 and captures product references and factual follow-up in s6. Missing product details are checked manually with effort retained.
Only native links and note fields are proposed. No automated personal advice or health-data inference is introduced.
The ordinary author save remains fully retained and ungated. No separate follow-up send is implied.
unknowns: Frequency and size of existing demonstration notes
research_questions: Do linked product instructions and a short note layout save observed clerical time without reducing live instruction?

already_counted.description: Physical preparation and all live demonstration and teaching work

incremental.description: Maintain product links and demonstration-note layout

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected products, demonstration and intended client checked immediately before demonstration; changed product or feedback requires a new check.
Exact application advice and intended client checked against current product instructions and understanding before instruction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R97 gives3 gross minus1 upkeep =2 net. Low: references lack product identifiers and notes are bespoke, leaving lookup9.5 and note4.5 plus85 unchanged, R99; net0. High: product links match but follow-up wording remains individual, leaving9+4+85=98 retained; net1 after1 upkeep. Physical demonstration and teaching stay full.

role.altitude: Keep artistic and personal makeup work human while improving the supporting design and client records.
reach: Share traceable character and production references with costume colleagues
Maintain concise demonstration context for authorised colleagues
role.ambitious_version: An artist with more usable reference and design records and protected time for practical creative work.
